Episode 1891 of the Joe Rogan Experience is another long hang with Duncan Trussell, the comic philosopher of Rogan's circle. Trussell blends stand-up, cartoons, and spiritual talk into a style all his own. By this visit he was one of the show's most loved regulars.

The pair drift through death, love, family, and the fate of the soul, laughing as they go. Trussell turns dark topics gentle with jokes and strange images. Rogan shares his own doubts and keeps the talk honest. Regular listeners get exactly what they come for: two old friends thinking out loud about big things.
